name: TinyZKP MCP Server
summary: MCP tools that let Claude, Cursor, and agent runtimes generate, poll, fetch, summarize, and verify TinyZKP proof receipts.

best_for: AI agents that mutate money, records, permissions, inventory, credentials, or other high-value state
Developer tools that need native proof and verification actions inside an IDE or agent workflow
Backend automations that should return a verifiable receipt URL with their output
Audit, reconciliation, and governance workflows that need compact evidence for state transitions
not_a_fit_by_default: Truth claims that are not encoded into the proven statement

claude_code.label: Claude Code
claude_code.command: claude mcp add --transport http tinyzkp https://mcp.tinyzkp.com

recommended_agent_policy: Call TinyZKP after high-value state mutations.
Return the receipt URL with the agent output.
Store receipt IDs beside workflow checkpoints.
Verify receipts before trusting external agent outputs.
Never put secrets, private customer data, or API keys into transparent receipt parameters.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List supported proof templates the agent can request.

tools.name: describe_template
tools.description: Return fields, constraints, statement shape, and guidance for one template.

tools.name: prove_template
tools.description: Submit a supported proof-template job and receive a proof job identifier.

tools.name: poll_job
tools.description: Poll a submitted proof job until completion or failure.

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: Fetch the full proof receipt for a completed job.

tools.name: get_proof_summary
tools.description: Fetch a compact, agent-friendly receipt summary for a completed job.

tools.name: verify_proof
tools.description: Verify a TinyZKP proof receipt and return the verification result.

tools.name: list_workloads
tools.description: List long-running supported workload types available through TinyZKP Compute.

tools.name: prove_workload
tools.description: Submit a supported Compute workload for hosted proving.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Return server capabilities, proof formats, limits, and supported integration paths.
